notes:
Account summary: BrambleBridge builds an in-app help center and smart search for mid-market SaaS apps. Evaluating Redwood to replace a mix of self-hosted search + open API cost spike. Started with Hosted API to validate quality; moving toward Dedicated if unit economics and residency checks out.

Key requirements / constraints:
- Workloads: real-time support chat (avg session ~9 turns), document search and reranking for KB (3M documents), nightly embedding refreshes.
- Latency SLOs: p95 < 120ms for reranking calls, p99 < 300ms for chat turn (interactive path).
- Throughput: steady 40-60 qps during peak; batch offline embedding jobs 2M docs/day window.
- Cost sensitivity: target < $200 / 1M tokens equivalent for inference-heavy flows; CTO wants 30-40% unit cost reduction over current setup.
- Data residency: primary in us-west; legal requires contractual language around residency for EU customers.

What we did in evaluation:
- Demo covered Hosted API, streaming for chat, embeddings with semantic search integration. Team liked responsivity and tools (tracing, token-level cost).
- POC plan: 3-week window. Week 1 baseline hosted API (functional + quality), Week 2 cost workshop + Dedicated sizing exercise, Week 3 dedicated pilot (if budget approved).
- Cost-optimization workshop notes (03/02):
  • Batching: recommended dynamic micro-batching for reranking path (combine small queries into 8-16 batch sizes) to improve GPU utilization. Expect ~25-35% token cost drop for reranking.
  • Caching: prefix/KV cache for conversational flows (session-level KV) — estimated 12-18% reduction in token compute by avoiding repeated context recompute.
  • Quantization profiles: run INT8 candidate on non-critical reranking models, FP16 for chat; Redwood suggests one A/B variant to validate quality delta. Early sims show 5-9% latency improvement, cost down ~20% for quantized variant.
  • Unit economics: Redwood presented slot-based cost model for Dedicated; Diego modeled a 3-node pool vs. 6-node pool for peak — break-even around 4-5 months given BrambleBridge traffic profile.

Quotes and paraphrases from stakeholders:
- "We need predictable bills — spikes are killing our margins." — VP of Product (A. Patel)
- "If we can get 30% cost savings with no regression on NDCG for search, CTO signs off." — CTO (E. Morgan)

POC open items / risks:
- Need legal sign-off on EU data residency addendum (in progress).
- Dedicated sizing: uncertain burst behavior for cyclical marketing campaigns (need traces from last 6 months).
- Quality validation: reranking NDCG threshold to be defined; security team wants audit log sample.
